title: Anyone else running?
content: I feel like a consistent problem i have in my mallworld dreams is that i am running from something. Consistently, but especially if im in the hotel or the actual city attached to my mall. The hotel in my dreams always has a large grand staircase in the lobby, in red and gold, and the carpet is always some shade of red on all the floors, but there's too many rooms, too many floors, and the library and shops attached have something in them. I dont know what i did to make myself a target in mallworld but it seems like every other time im there i am running from something or someone (First time posting in this thread but ive been having mallworld dreams constantly for somewhere around ten years)
